summary: Cushman & Wakefield Ltd. filed an 8-K announcing that its wholly-owned subsidiary, the Issuer, elected to partially redeem $100 million of its outstanding $650 million 6.750% Senior Secured Notes due May 2028. The redemption price is 100% of principal plus accrued interest, with the redemption date set for May 15, 2026. This is a debt reduction / capital return move; no board recommendation, advisor, or premium. The trustee, Wilmington Trust, will execute the notice. Watch for further liability management or potential refinancing. Risk-arb angle: None; it is a straightforward partial redemption.
